jobs.description:
At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Help shape how KMD engages strategic accounts - connecting key societal agendas with customers’ strategic priorities through marketing advisory, customer insight and close collaboration with sales.

As Marketing Advisor, you will own marketing plans, campaigns and commercial communication from planning to execution on strategic accounts. Working with sales, subject-matter experts and corporate communication, you will position KMD as a strategic partner and create meaningful commercial conversations.

What you will do:

• Set the direction: develop the marketing strategy and annual plan for strategic accounts together with commercial stakeholders, based on customer needs and business priorities.

• Create demand: plan and execute integrated demand-generation activities across relevant channels.

• Make complex topics clear: translate technology, customer challenges and KMD’s capabilities into relevant messages and compelling value propositions.

• Work closely with sales: support strategic accounts and select sales opportunities with targeted account-based marketing throughout the buying journey.

• Learn from results: together with our Performance Specialist measure performance and use data, customer insights and commercial outcomes to improve activities.

What you bring:

You have minimum 3 years of B2B marketing experience and enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You are fluent in Danish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• Experience translating customer and commercial priorities into marketing strategies, plans and integrated demand-generation campaigns.

• The ability to explain complex topics clearly and develop messages that show customers why a solution is relevant to them.

• An understanding of how marketing and sales work together to develop opportunities and move customer conversations forward.

• Experience with account-based marketing (ABM), pursuit marketing or bid marketing is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to advise senior commercial colleagues while working collaboratively across teams.

• A structured, proactive approach, with the ability to prioritise and manage several initiatives while moving between planning and execution.

• Confidence in using AI tools responsibly to support your day-to-day work.

Experience in technology, IT, consulting, professional services or another complex solution environment.

Why join KMD?

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

This is an opportunity to shape the marketing approach for KMD’s strategic accounts and see your work connected directly with customer conversations and business priorities, while joining an ambitious marketing team that is developing how it contributes to KMD’s growth.

Interested? Let’s hear from you

Want to connect key societal agendas with customers’ strategic priorities through B2B marketing? We would love to hear from you.

Are you passionate about supporting colleagues offshore? Do you want to work in the green offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then you might be the Crewing Coordinator we are looking for.

Cadeler is a global partner in offshore wind farm construction and maintenance, and we are part of an industry that is now, more than ever, both relevant and in high demand. As our industry continues to grow, so do we!

**What will you do?

**As our new Crewing Coordinator, you will be in charge of effectively allocating vessel crews and supporting various initiatives for our colleagues offshore. You will support the implementation of policies and procedures while supporting the development of systems in this realm, for both colleagues on and offshore.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Coordinate the scheduling of vessel crews via electronic rotas so personnel are allocated effectively, ensuring manning requirements are met.

• Coordinate the booking of flights, rail tickets, hire cars and hotels for both vessel crew changes (and training courses where necessary).

• Assist the HR/ Head of Marine HR with the induction and initial documentation for offshore crew.

• Support the implementation of recruitment campaigns to source personnel to fill offshore crewing requirements.

• Advise and support project and department manager’s resourcing needs.

• Input data into the HR database and create reports to be analysed by the HR/ Crewing Manager.

• Maintaining all relevant databases including personnel files and offshore crew certification.

• Aiding in internal and external audits when required

• Liaising with internal and external stakeholders in defining crew change requirements and crewing levels.

**To succeed in this role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means you will have a natural interest and care for the environment and our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Your environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for someone who can stay and work calmly in a high-pressure environment. You have a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and take pride in delivering tasks efficiently and to a high standard.

We think you will be a good match if you:

• 4+ years of work experience in an office environment, preferably in the crew coordination space

• Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office Package

• Strong communication skills and proficiency in English (written and spoken)

• Organised, structured and able to handle multiple priorities

• Prior knowledge of Compas or Omega is an advantage

**Why Cadeler?

**At Cadeler, we believe in building what matters. As part of a global team working in the offshore wind industry, you will contribute to projects that support the energy transition and help shape a more sustainable future.

We believe in trust, collaboration and shared responsibility. We give our people the opportunity to take ownership, develop their skills and grow together, while maintaining high standards in everything we do.

Join us and become part of a team where your contribution matters, your ideas are valued and we set the standard together.

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler has a global presence, with offices in Copenhagen, Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam, and Taipei, alongside colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIVs).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don’t hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible.

Please be aware, that if hired for the position the title will be Crewing Logistics Coordinator.

If you have any questions regarding the position or practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

**ORDERYOYO

****Lead Software Engineer – Payments

**Remote - **_Must be Copenhagen based

_**

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

• Competitive salary

**About The Role

**At OrderYOYO, payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Payments to help us build a more resilient, scalable, and compliant payments operating model — across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — across a rapidly growing, international restaurant platform.

****Role Mission

****Own and evolve OrderYOYO's payments capabilities — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

****Core Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate payment-domain services, including gateway integrations and payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.

• Implement marketplace capabilities where relevant: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.

• Build robust “flow-of-funds” primitives — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails — that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.

• Integrate with PSP and partner tooling, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.

• Implement dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and collaborate with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.

• Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.

• Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain through automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements — and mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to shared standards and documentation. Payments is too critical to be tribal knowledge.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.

• Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.

• A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.

• Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.

• Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).

• Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK66,000/ month

• A role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the services you build.

• The opportunity to work on revenue-critical production systems.

• A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Cell Bank Scientist, CMC Drug Development
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

Ready to bring together microbial science, GMP manufacturing and project responsibility in a senior role where your work directly supports the development of future medicines? Join our Microbial Cell Bank team, where every drug substance begins - we manufacture and maintain the cell banks that are the starting point for drug substance production all over the world. Working cross-functionally across projects, you will combine your scientific expertise with GMP responsibility and help drive continuous improvement of our Cell Bank operation. Ready to take the lead where every medicine begins? Apply today!

**What you’ll do

**As a Senior Scientist in the Microbial Cell Bank, you will take a leading professional role in activities related to the production and lifecycle management of our cell banks. You will take ownership of complex tasks and projects, working closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, QA, QC and project teams. With your experience, you will help navigate cross-functional processes, identify solutions and contribute to developing both our processes and ways of working. Depending on your experience and interests, the role provides an opportunity to build deeper expertise and potentially develop towards a specialist position.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Planning and supporting GMP manufacture of microbial Master Cell Banks (MCBs) and Working Cell Banks (WCBs).

• Taking project responsibility for cell bank projects from incoming Initial Cell Clone (ICC) through production, characterisation, release and lifecycle activities.

• Preparing and maintaining specifications, production documentation and other GMP documentation.

• Coordinating activities and solving issues across QA, QC, project teams and other key stakeholders.

• Handling deviations and change requests and driving systematic problem solving.

• Supporting regulatory activities, audits, inspections and responses to Health Authority questions.

• Driving continuous improvements to cell bank processes and ways of working.

• Contributing to the continued digitalisation of our Cell Bank operation and exploring how new technologies, including AI, can support smarter and more efficient ways of working.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you hold a relevant master’s degree within biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related scientific field. You also have:

• a solid background from the pharmaceutical industry and a strong understanding of GMP.

• hands-on skills in microbial cultivation and knowledge of microbiology, molecular biology, cellular biology and analytical science.

• a proven ability to navigate a complex organisation and work across functions.

• a strong quality mindset combined with an analytical and pragmatic approach to problem solving.

• an interest in digitalisation and new technology. Experience with AI is an advantage, but curiosity and motivation to explore how AI can improve our work are equally important.

On a personal level, you are collaborative, curious and motivated by taking professional and independent ownership of activities and projects involving multiple stakeholders. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and contributing to the development of others while continuously strengthening your own expertise. You communicate effectively across functions and organisational levels and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when you see opportunities to improve.

Who you’ll work with

CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

Cell Banks are at the starting point of drug substance production and play an important role in bringing new medicines through CMC Drug Development. We are a team of approximately 16 scientists and laboratory technicians working with microbial cell banks in Bagsværd and mammalian cell banks in Hillerød, with an ambition to collaborate closely and share knowledge across the two locations.

We have a strong focus on quality, collaboration and delivering for our projects. At the same time, we are ambitious about developing the Cell Bank area and continuously improving our processes, facilities and digital ways of working. We value an open and collaborative environment where we help each other, share knowledge and believe that having fun at work is an important part of being a strong team.

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 651,000 to DKK 956,900, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Please apply by 22 November 2026.

**

Due to the short deadline, please apply as soon as possible. We review CVs and invite candidates to interview on an ongoing basis.**

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Associate Director Jesper Roland Jørgensen at +45 30797885.

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us in the Cell Bank team. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

Turn financial data into insights and support for decisions that help build future manufacturing capacity for patients worldwide. As Finance Partner in Drug Product Manufacturing (DPM) Expansions, you will be part of strengthening cost transparency and financial reporting, combined with improving forecasts and helping secure right resource planning across a multi-billion DKK investment portfolio. Your insights will support across the Global Project Management Office (GPMO) and selected expansion sites. You will combine independent ownership with close collaboration in an experienced finance team. Key is that you are ready for a step learning curve and take ownership in your work and bring high energy and motivation to make a difference within delivering sound financial management.

What you'll bring

You can translate complex financial information into clear business insights and recommendations and build trusted relationships with stakeholders from expansion sites to the finance community. For this role, the essentials are:

• A master’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration or a related discipline.

• Relevant experience in financial planning and analysis, business finance, controlling or business partnering, including independent delivery of reporting and analysis.

• Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, with close attention to data quality.

• Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain findings simply and build a compelling financial story.

• Fluency in written and spoken English, together with a structured approach to deadlines and commitments.

• Useful, but not essential: experience with financial planning systems and improving reporting through digital tools.

What you'll do

• Lead and coordinate the month-end closing process across capital expenditure, operating expenditure and workforce planning, bringing inputs together into a high-quality monthly management report.

• Consolidate and analyse operating expenditure (OPEX) and manning data for monthly reporting, budgets and forecasts, explaining deviations and identifying risks early.

• Partner with GPMO budget owners to assess cost and manning, as well as support resource prioritisation within agreed budgets.

• Work with selected site project finance teams to improve collaboration and insights even further to secure sharpen OPEX financial execution and forecast, as well as strong financial follow-through and follow up on assumptions, deviations and agreed actions.

• Challenge assumptions and resolve complex financial issues within your scope, while seeking input from senior colleagues when it adds value.

• Simplify reporting and finance processes through common standards, efficient workflows and effective use of digital tools and AI adoption.

Who you'll work with

You will join the Finance & Procurement team within the GPMO for DPM Expansions. The team brings together finance management, financial compliance, procurement, contract management and digital solutions. Your closest partners will include experienced finance colleagues and corporate finance functions, GPMO budget owners, site project finance teams and digital colleagues across the expansion portfolio.

DPM Expansions delivers major capital investment projects that establish manufacturing capacity for current and future demand, working with standardised equipment and processes, advanced technology and flexible facility designs, with a strong focus on safety, cost, time and good manufacturing practice compliance. You will contribute financial clarity that helps these teams make timely, well-informed choices.

What you can expect here

You will have independent ownership of defined processes and stakeholder relationships, while having close internal collaborations and sparring with finance and investment colleagues. The role offers broad exposure to a global major investment portfolio and the opportunity to strengthen your business partnering, financial reporting and process-improvement skills. You can expect a collaborative environment where asking questions, constructively challenging assumptions and sharing knowledge are valued.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn financial performance into practical decisions that support future manufacturing capacity, apply for the Finance Partner role no later than 22 November 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions, please reach out to Sr. Finance Partner - Anders Hvidt, +45 3444 4375

Vi søger nye stabile medarbejdere til vores hyggelige bar i Aalborg centrum.

Vi leder efter dig der er ansvarsbevidst, selvstændig og smilende. Erfaring er ikke nødvendigt.

We are looking for reliable bartenders for our cozy bar in central Aalborg city.

We are looking for you if you are responsible, an independent worker, and have a positive attitude. Experience isn´t necessary.

Scan Con Constraction is not a Temp Company (Er ikke et Vikar firma)

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Skills:

·         English - must be able to communicate in English 

·         Technical Knowledge: Proficient in reading blueprints and technical drawings.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

·         Safety Adherence: Strict compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) standards and proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

 

Experience:

• 
Experience is good to have but that's not necessary

We Offer you:

·         Full time job in Denmark 

·         Danish contract signed with Scan Con Construction, work for Scan Con Construction

·         Attractive salary (also vacation money, Free Choice Account, Labor market pension)

·         We guarantee 37 hours per week with possibilities for overtime (The normal average weekly working hours are according to the Union agreement as well as any local agreements)

·         Flight tickets

·         Transport to/ from job 

·         Accommodation 

·         Safety courses

·         Work tools and clothes

·         Help with applying for a residence and work permit after the Fast track scheme

·         Health insurance / Medical help

 

INTERESTED?

If you have any questions about the position, or if you wish to apply, you are welcome to contact Magda Kosecka HR Administrator on phone: +45 32 82 00 00 or send your application to cv@scan-con.dk – in e-mail title please write references: Steel Fitters

jobs.occupation: Engineer with Administrative Background and interested in Aviation.
jobs.description:
AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

• 
Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

• 
Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

• 
Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

• 
Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

• 
Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

• 
Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

• 
Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

• 
Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

• 
Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

• 
Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

• 
Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

• 
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

• 
The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

• 
A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

• 
An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

• 
An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

• 
A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

• 
Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

• 
The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be conducted throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

Please use the reference “Engineer or Aircraft Technician – 2026” when submitting your application.

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Interviews will take place at our offices in Sønderborg, Denmark.

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you to the AIR ALSIE team!

Student worker – AI & Finance

Are you passionate about making a difference in the world through innovative BioSolutions?

ALGIECEL is a BioSolutions company on a mission to deliver sustainable, high-quality ingredients at scale – meeting the growing global demand without pressuring our planet’s ecosystem. Harnessing nature’s own way and putting it to use at industrial scale, we grow microalgae using light and CO2 in modular photobioreactors.

With the way we feed the world today, we are overexploiting planetary boundaries. There is a critical need for reliable partners who can translate innovation into industrial capacity for sustainable ingredients at scale. ALGIECEL provides an alternative with low CO2, water and land use, for customers that want to decarbonize their value chain.

You will play an important role in helping us drive the daily challenges of a start-up, with hands-on learning experience in AI, operations, finance & fundraising, as well as project management and engagement with the company’s leadership team and relevant external stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who can catch a lot of tasks and execute with quality those that matter. This role is perfect for a motivated student eager to step into a dynamic and fast paced work environment with high diversity of learning- and career development opportunities.

WHO ARE YOU?

• You are a 1st year master student based in Copenhagen, with studies in business, finance or Data/AI/Automation

• You are top of your class and consider yourself a high achiever among your peers.

• You have excellent written and verbal English skills (Danish is not a requirement)

• You have relevant work experience, as well as international experience.

WHAT WILL YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES BE AT ALGIECEL?

• You will drive the standardization and automation of existing operational workstreams in the company, while developing the company's AI toolbox.

• You will apply the above as well to support internal financial reporting to management and other relevant stakeholders.

• You will support and drive efforts to increase adoption of AI tools across the diverse team, as well as explore and execute use cases in parallel.

• You will participate in efforts related to fundraising for public grants, as well as equity rounds.

• Further, there will be ad hoc tasks and project, generally in support and collaboration of the company's Chief of Staff as your direct manager, as well as to the CEO and CFO.

HOW WILL YOU EXCEL IN YOUR ROLE?

• You try to add value to projects, in excess of what your instructions were.

• You are proactive, find things that need fixing and speak your mind, while also enjoying feedback and coaching from your team members.

• You enjoy optimizing workstreams and developing innovative solutions for getting to a stronger output with the same resources

• You consider yourself skilled at working with excel, as well as well-known, open-source LLMs and agent platforms.

• You have a continuously growing portfolio of tools, which you purposefully add to, such as for automation, modelling and related tasks, formerly executed manually in excel.

• You know you are, for now, a junior part of a larger team, but you want to become more impactful by taking on more responsibility and growing with the company (also full-time).

• You know your strengths, as well as your development areas and enjoy working on both with purpose.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• An in-office student job with 15-20 hours weekly, located at the Danish Technological Institute near Taastrup.

• A competitive salary as well as IT equipment and subscriptions provided to get your job done.

• A hands-on learning platform, working together with former senior executives and leadership from companies such as Novonesis, Ørsted, Topsoe, Saxo Bank, Cargill and AB Agri.

• Being part of an ambitious and diverse team, on track of an ambitious scaling journey in a competitive industry

For questions to the company, position and hiring process, you can contact Head of Finance/Chief of Staff Jascha Jäger under career@algiecel.com.

Site Compliance Lead

East Denmark: Hillerød, Bagsværd and Måløv

Your impact begins here

As Site Compliance Lead, you will help create fair, responsible and legally compliant working conditions across Novo Nordisk construction sites in East Denmark. You will bring clarity to complex compliance matters, strengthen consistent practices and help project teams manage risk effectively. By guiding operational activities and addressing irregularities with sound judgement, you will support compliant, efficient and sustainable project execution at our sites in Hillerød, Bagsværd and Måløv.

What you’ll bring

You combine strong Site Compliance expertise with the confidence to coordinate activities across teams, contractors and other stakeholders. You can assess complex information, make timely decisions and communicate requirements clearly, including when conversations are challenging.

• A relevant technical background, for example as a construction engineer, marine engineer or in a comparable field.

• Several years of relevant compliance experience, preferably from construction, large-scale projects, a regulated industry or a similar operational environment.

• Knowledge of labour relations, employment legislation, working environment requirements and the legal and regulatory context for construction activities.

• Experience with compliance monitoring, investigations, risk assessments and the management of non-compliance cases.

• Experience coordinating or leading employees, teams or operational activities.

• Professional working proficiency in Danish and English.

You will also need integrity, discretion and strong professional judgement. You are comfortable working independently, balancing changing priorities and escalating significant issues when required.

What you’ll do

• Ensure right staffing of Site Compliance Consultants and Safety Induction Consultants at our 3 construction locations in East Denmark, currently Hillerød, Bagsværd and Måløv.

• Coordinate onboarding and training of consultants, helping colleagues apply requirements consistently in their daily work.

• Monitor contractor performance, identify patterns and emerging risks, prepare timely reports.

• Help ensure that contractors, suppliers and their employees comply with applicable Danish labour legislation and Novo Nordisk Site Compliance requirements.

• Manage compliance breaches and irregularities, applying professional judgement to assess risk and determine appropriate next steps.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Site Compliance, a specialist function within API Environment, Health & Safety and Site Compliance that supports Novo’s construction sites in Denmark. The team helps projects meet relevant authority requirements, applicable legislation and internal standards while maintaining progress in project execution.

You will be reporting to the Head of Site Compliance, and your closest partners will include project organisations, Construction Health and Safety, Site Security, Category Owners, Communications, Project Management and other relevant site functions. You will also work directly with contractors and suppliers, bringing different perspectives together and creating clarity when requirements or priorities are complex.

What you can expect here

You will have the opportunity to shape how Site Compliance is delivered across major construction environments and to contribute directly to safer, fairer and more consistent ways of working. You will be trusted to use your expertise, take ownership and help colleagues solve compliance challenges. The department values collaboration, professionalism and a working environment in which people share knowledge and recognise collective progress.

Salary and Benefits

The Annual Base Salary for the role ranges from DKK 570,200 - 838,100, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Your impact begins here

As P&O Business Partner, you will be the trusted advisor to the Vice President of API Business Support and their leadership team, helping them lead well and perform at their best. Working largely on the shop floor in Kalundborg, you will coach leaders, strengthen daily ways of working and bring the people perspective into organisational change. Your impact will show in stronger leadership, clearer direction and a workplace where colleagues can contribute and grow.

What you’ll bring

You are an HR generalist who is at home alongside business leaders, and you enjoy being close to the work.

• 
5+ years of relevant HR experience, including 3+ years partnering with business leaders.

• 
Experience working closely with leadership teams, with solid knowledge across HR and a focus on linking business strategy and organisational development.

• 
Broad experience of developing leaders through coaching, sparring and feedback.

• 
Specialist knowledge of performance management, including handling absence and performance cases.

• 
Business and financial understanding from consulting, industry or a leadership role.

• 
Excellent interpersonal skills, high integrity and the credibility to build trusting relationships.

• 
Analytical, structured and operational: you make things happen, and stay ready for change.

• 
Fluency in spoken and written English.

Useful, but not essential:

• 
A postgraduate or master’s degree, or 5+ years of equivalent experience.

• 
An HR professional certification.

• 
Experience from the healthcare industry.

What you’ll do

In partnership with the business and your P&O manager, you will help leaders and teams perform, with a strong presence on the shop floor.

• 
Be a trusted advisor to the Vice President and Leadership Team, giving strategic sparring and helping them sharpen their own thinking.

• 
Coach leaders on personal leadership and skills, and help them reflect on how they lead.

• 
Develop and sustain shop floor management by coaching leaders in the daily diary, covering structure, process, tools, behaviour and leadership.

• 
Strengthen Leadership Team performance and a clear framework for evaluating and reviewing leaders, and support how The Novo Way shows up in everyday behaviour.

• 
Plan and run core people processes, including goal setting, the salary and bonus review, engagement, talent management and individual development plans.

• 
Identify the need for organisational change, bring the people perspective into it and facilitate strategy discussions. You will also lead cross-organisational projects and own a process within API P&O Manufacturing.

Collaboration and strong partnerships are at the heart of this role. Therefore, we expect you to work onsite in Kalundborg 4–5 days per week, enabling close collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders.

Who you’ll work with

You will join API P&O Manufacturing HR Business Partnering and report to the Associate Director, P&O Business Partnering. You will provide HR support to API Business Support and one department in API IO M4. You will be based on site in Kalundborg, where your day-to-day partners are the Vice President, the Leadership Team and managers across the area.

Beyond the site, you will collaborate with fellow API P&O Business Partners, GMS P&O Business Partnering, the relevant P&O centres of expertise, Employee Relations, COHS and union representatives. Competing priorities and different expectations will be part of the job. You will bridge them, keep messages aligned and help decisions move forward with clarity and speed.

Hiring manager: Jan Drehn, Associate Director P&O Business Partner, JDRH@novonordisk.com.

What you can expect here

You will have real influence in a complex environment: trusted to work independently, represent the Vice President’s area across the wider API organisation and address dilemmas professionally and diligently. You will help shape the processes and ways of working that affect the area and API more broadly.

You will grow through leadership development work in the Business Support Leadership Team and across P&O Business Partnering and be supported to perform at your best while being trusted to take ownership.

What we offer

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.
